ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity black pixels to 15% high-intensity white pixels, with white concentrations localized to the distal tips and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patch on the distal corner of the left lobe (approx. coordinates 150,150 relative to lobe tip) and a more mottled, fragmented white distribution on the right distal tip. White mottling also extends along the upper 20% of the trailing edge on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 115 degrees with a moderate depth-to-width ratio visible above the waterline splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5-15 pixels. Right lobe exhibits significantly higher irregularity and sharper 'peaks' at the distal extremity compared to the more rhythmic serration pattern on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge curve transitioning to a sharp, tapered distal point; trailing edge follows a generally concave path toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of roughly 5-8 circular high-contrast white pixel groups (diameter 2-4 pixels) on the upper black surface of the right lobe; isolated white spots present on the central dark region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged, irregular profile on the upper-most edge of the right lobe suggesting previous tissue loss or significant wear relative to the smoother left lobe profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'spray' pattern of white pigmentation on the left lobe trailing edge, transitioning from solid white at the tip to fine-grained white speckling toward the center.
